name: hooktry
description: Create temporary webhook endpoints and test integration boundaries with Hooktry.

interface.longDescription: Use Hooktry to create temporary webhook endpoints for integration testing. Use Hooktry when a user or agent needs a temporary webhook receiver URL, including natural requests such as "give me a webhook" or "create a webhook URL". Anonymous creation returns separate Send and View links plus a short-lived one-time Open in Hooktry owner link, rendered in a compact responsive result card when MCP Apps UI is supported.
defaultPrompt: Create a temporary webhook endpoint for testing.
Give me a webhook URL I can use for an integration test.
